Name: admissionDrugID
Comment: surrogate key for the admission drug

Name: patientUnitStayID
Comment: a globally unique identifier (GUID) used as a foreign key link to the patient table

Name: drugOffset
Comment: number of minutes from unit admit time that the admission drug was administered

Name: drugEnteredOffset
Comment: number of minutes from unit admit time that the admission drug was entered

Name: drugNoteType
Comment: unique note picklist types e.g.: Comprehensive Progress Admission Intubation

Name: specialtyType
Comment: physician specialty picklist types e.g.: anesthesiology gastroenterology oncology

Name: userType
Comment: eCareManager user picklist types e.g.: eICU Physician Nurse Attending Physician

Name: rxIncluded
Comment: Does the Note have associated Rx data: True or False

Name: writtenIneICU
Comment: Was the Note written in the eICU: True or False

Name: drugName
Comment: name of the selected admission drug e.g.: POTASSIUM CHLORIDE/D5NS METAXALONE PRAVACHOL

Name: drugDosage
Comment: dosage of the admission drug e.g.: 20.0000 400.000

Name: drugUnit
Comment: picklist units of the admission drug e.g.: mg mg/kg patch

Name: drugAdmitFrequency
Comment: picklist frequency with which the admission drug is administred e.g.: PRN twice a day at bedtime

Name: drugHiclSeqno
Comment: HICL sequence number for the drug e.g.: 2734 33199 20492
